scope: Final-source isolated native/full stages, desktop DPR1/mobile DPR2, normal and four-times CPU. Terminal stories span 36 seconds and complete two original command cycles plus session changes and dragging; other instruments span eight seconds with interrupted input. RAF throughput, every >25ms gap, long tasks, source state, native draw counts and raw CDP frame/paint/layout trace hashes are retained. RGB keeps its original paint cadence. Fonts are prepared before mount. Readiness/FCP exclude public route/module transfer. No per-frame model inspection or pixel readback occurs during the measured loop. Measurements leave final timing/stress gates open.
